newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar ranged on low demand, limited supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar ranged on low demand, limited supply.

text.p: Sugar prices held steady at the reduced level in a narrow price band on local markets on Wednesday, dealers said.
"Consumer demand was low despite the Diwali festival but limited supplies kept market quiet," a dealer said.

The federal government has increased supplies to the public distribution system which in turn slackened demand in the open market, dealers said. Arrivals were low on limited offerings by mill owners. In ready delivery sugar S-30 was steady at 1,290/1,325 rupees per quintal while M-30 was quiet at 1,320/1,360 rupees per quintal.
Sugar mill delivery was steady at 1,190/1,200 rupees per quintal. Overall market sentiment remained subdued at the close and traders were expecting narrow price movement in the coming days.
